    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Every pending change is a focusable button labelled like \"Suggestion 2 of 4: replace “available” with “live”. Press Y to accept, N to reject\""
      - listitem: Removed words are a <del>, new words an <ins>; the side that was dropped is hidden from screen readers once decided
      - listitem: Each decision, Accept all, Reject all and Undo are announced in a polite live region with the number left
      - listitem: After the last decision focus moves to Undo, so the keyboard is never stranded; the hidden toolbar is inert
      - listitem: Popover buttons are labelled and keep focus on the change; visible focus rings throughout
      - listitem: "The prev/next arrows never steal focus: a focused change hands focus to the next one, otherwise the change is highlighted while focus stays on the arrow"
      - listitem: Deleted words sit on a red tint and are struck, added words on a green one – color is never the only cue (strike-through, <del> and <ins>)
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Accepting shrinks the struck words to nothing while the green tint fades and the new words settle into the text
      - listitem: Rejecting does the opposite – the new words shrink away, the strike-through and red tint fade
      - listitem: The popover fades up above a change and steps quickly from one change to the next
      - listitem: The arrows only scroll the page when the next change is out of view (smoothly, or instantly with reduced motion)
      - listitem: The toolbar cross-fades into "All changes reviewed" and the check draws itself
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion every change happens instantly
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Fills its container; the paragraph wraps freely and changes wrap across lines with their tints
      - listitem: The popover stays inside the card horizontally, down to 320px wide
      - listitem: In cards narrower than 360px the prev/next arrows step aside; on touch screens the popover buttons grow and drop the key hints
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Pass the user's text as original and the model's rewrite as suggested – diffWords groups adjacent removals and insertions into one change
      - listitem: Ask the model for a rewrite that keeps unchanged sentences verbatim; the fewer stray edits, the easier the review
      - listitem: Write the result back with onDone (or onChange for drafts); undecided changes keep the original words
      - listitem: diffWords is exported, so you can count edits or build the same segments on the server
